issues.issue: The two-tier hard dependency as specified cannot match on lookup. Design step (2) puts the data revision into SemanticDependencies.indexGeneration on the builder used by BOTH publish and lookup (LmdbPipelinePlanCache.java:373-380 is shared by publishDecision :250 and lookupRequest :399). For the guarantee-only tier it then stores withIndexGenerationDependency(0L, predicateRangeIdentity). matchesCurrent (LmdbPlanDecisionCache.java:255-262) compares `indexGeneration == current.indexGeneration` for every dependent version, so stored 0L vs current dataRevision (non-zero after the first commit, and always non-zero once 3.3.3 seeds it from the LMDB txn id) mismatches on every lookup -> replan('semantic-dependency-mismatch') forever. The same breakage hits today's packed PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA path (publishDecision :251-253 keeps semanticDependencies(context) with 0L), which the design folds into the guarantee tier. The claim 'the lookup side needs no branching' is false: the lookup side cannot know which tier the stored version used.
issues.suggestion: Separate the two dependencies in the record: add `long dataRevision` + `boolean dataRevisionDependent` next to the existing `indexIdentity`/`indexGenerationDependent` pair (keep indexGeneration at 0L for the identity tier, exactly as today), populate dataRevision on both publish and lookup, and make matchesCurrent compare `(!dataRevisionDependent || dataRevision == current.dataRevision) && (!indexGenerationDependent || Objects.equals(indexIdentity, current.indexIdentity))`. Mirror the fields in RefreshComputation (:522-529) and publishRefresh (:1311-1314). Unit test: guaranteeDependentPlanIsReusedAtANewDataRevisionWhenIdentityUnchanged (publish at context(17) with guarantee tier, lookup at context(18) same PredicateRangeIdentity -> USE/USE_AND_REFRESH, not REPLAN) plus the existing PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA e2e (LmdbPackedPredicateRangePlanningTest) must stay green.

issues.issue: After a hard-dependency mismatch the replacement plan can never be published: lookupVersion returns replan('semantic-dependency-mismatch') (LmdbPlanDecisionCache.java:1628-1630) without touching semanticValidity; publishBuild refuses any build for a family whose current version is VALID (:1120-1127 'A build is not refresh or variant publication authority ... return false', and again :1147-1153 under admissionLock). The only path to HARD_INVALID is FamilyVersion.hardInvalid (:763) called from markEvidenceChanged (:1578), which has no production caller (grep: none). So with the design, every anchored query family replans synchronously on EVERY invocation after its first commit until LRU eviction, and the decision cache is effectively disabled for FILTER-anchored shapes. The same latent gap exists today for PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA plans.
issues.suggestion: When lookupVersion observes a mismatch on a dependent (hard) dimension, CAS the family to `observed.hardInvalid(...)` (and removeAliases) before returning replan, so the following publishBuild replaces the version (:1120-1127 only refuses VALID). Alternatively let publishBuild replace a VALID version whose semanticDependencies no longer matchesCurrent(publication.semanticDependencies()). Add LmdbPlanDecisionCacheTest: hardDependencyMismatchAllowsReplacementBuild (publish rev 17 dependent; lookup rev 18 -> REPLAN; publishBuild rev 18 -> true; lookup rev 18 -> USE) and an e2e assertion in exactStoredTermAnchorMustNotSurviveCommitThatAddsValueEqualTerm that the THIRD run after the commit is a pipelinePlanCacheHit=true.

issues.issue: `catch (RuntimeException)` in LmdbCascadesOptimizer.optimizeWithResult (:175-186) is too wide in one direction: a cancelled/timed-out query whose planning throws QueryInterruptedException (or any RuntimeException raised because the thread was interrupted, e.g. TripleStore.snapshotCoordinates :3336-3338 converts InterruptedException to IOException, PackedPlanCache.Segment.beginFlight :693-698 converts it to IllegalStateException and swallows the interrupt flag re-set) would be turned into a WARN + fallback and the query would then execute the fallback plan instead of aborting. No current LMDB planner site throws QueryInterruptedException (grep of core/sail/lmdb main: none), so this is latent, but the fallback contract must exclude cancellation. The design also relies on 'planning has not mutated the input tree yet' (comment :178-181); this is true today because PackedPlanMaterializer builds a fresh tree, but it is not asserted.
issues.suggestion: Catch RuntimeException but rethrow QueryInterruptedException and any failure observed while Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted(); unwrap CompletionException before classifying. Add an assertion (or a cheap structural fingerprint check under `assertsEnabled`) that tupleExpr is unchanged when falling back. Add the fallback counter metric the design mentions so wp7 IAE fallbacks are visible in benchmarks.

issues.issue: Root-cause narrative is partly wrong (fix still works). The design says PackedQueryCacheIdentity.create(source) returns null for the p*/p+ and GROUP_CONCAT queries 'because they have no anonymous variables'; but the SPARQL parser creates constant Vars as anonymous (`_const_*`), and IdentitySurface.meetNode (PackedQueryCacheIdentity.java:258-259) collects every anonymous Var, so create() returns a NON-null identity for `?s <urn:p>* ?o` and for the GROUP_CONCAT query. The identity never engaged only because sameSource (PackedPlanCache.java:847-855) returns true on snapshot.equals(candidate) BEFORE consulting the identity. The proposed reorder (identity mismatch rejects first) is therefore the load-bearing change, and createPlanIdentity matters only for queries with unsafe canonicalization / no anonymous names. Also note the identity encoding covers minLength (PackedQueryCodec.java:993-994 payload) and the separator (:1278-1281 scalar), so the mismatch will fire.
issues.suggestion: Correct the narrative so the implementer does not treat 'identity == null' as the p*/p+ condition, and make the ordering the tested invariant (identityMismatchRejectsEqualLookingSource with a non-null identity on both sides and a deliberately lossy equals). Keep sameSource returning false when exactly one identity is null (mixed entries cannot occur within one process, but UNSUPPORTED-operator queries yield null from encode :85-90; with 3.8.4(3) those never publish, so document that dependency).

issues.issue: Metric-based assumption collection over-approximates and one drop site is not where the design points. annotateFiniteAnchor (LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer.java:1237-1261) stamps OPTIMIZER_GUARANTEE_ANCHOR_PREDICATE for every constant-predicate anchor, including exact stored-term anchors (:429-462 call it at :454) and anchors where knownRdfTermDomain returned Optional.empty(), so reusing that metric marks guarantee dependence where none was consumed (safe over-invalidation, but it defeats UseAndRefresh for data-independent VALUES anchors). The load-bearing guarantee consult that DROPS the filter is canMaterializeSmallLiteralFilterAnchor :1182 (via materializedSmallLiteralFilterAnchor :1085-1090), not the :1345-1365 range listed; :1205 (expandFiniteAnchor) is value-expansion only.
issues.suggestion: Stamp the dedicated optimizer.planAssumption.guaranteePredicate metric only at :1182 when `guarantee.isPresent()` decided the return value, and optimizer.planAssumption.committedSnapshot only at :454-460; do not derive assumptions from OPTIMIZER_GUARANTEE_ANCHOR_PREDICATE. Collect from the pre-Cascades tree in LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.computePlan (:112-116) as the design already recommends, since PackedPlanMaterializer rebuilds the tree and metrics on the source BSA are not carried over.

issues.issue: Ordering race kept by the design: TripleStore.commit makes the new data visible (`txnManager.reset()` :3412 after mdb_txn_commit in commitDurableStatementBatch :3294) BEFORE the revision moves (:3415). A planning thread that captures the revision in that window reads new data under the old revision and publishes a plan (or probe result) keyed on it; the next lookup at the old revision then reuses evidence from the newer snapshot. Setting dataRevision from mdb_txn_id keeps the same window.
issues.suggestion: Publish the new revision before `txnManager.reset()` (capture `mdb_txn_id(writeTxn)` before commit, store it right after mdb_txn_commit succeeds, then reset readers), or store both and have planners re-read the revision after opening their read txn (which is what LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh.execute already does at :89-95). Note this is the 3.5/3.10 race; document it as not fully closed by wp3.

issues.issue: A dataset whose only default graph is null (the store default graph) is treated as a restricted dataset downstream: LmdbCascadesOptimizer.datasetUsesStoreDefaults (:372-375) returns false for {null}, so `optimizer.datasetRestricted=true` is stamped (:163-170), LmdbPackedCostModel is built with storeDefaults=false (:322-325) and LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh computes storeDefaults=false (:108). The NPE fix is correct, but the SPARQL UPDATE compliance path will now plan with restricted-dataset semantics (less exact evidence, legacy learning refused).
issues.suggestion: Normalize `{null}`-only default graphs to 'store defaults' in one helper used by datasetUsesStoreDefaults and LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh, or at least document it as intended. Add the unit test the design lists plus one asserting DatasetIdentity.of(ds with addDefaultGraph(null)) != DatasetIdentity.of(ds with <urn:g>).

issues.issue: Waiter re-entry after a failed flight is under-specified: after await() returns null, beginFlight (PackedPlanCache.java:672-700) may return (a) a PlanEntry hit, (b) a NEW non-owner claim on a third thread's flight, or (c) ownership. Case (b) can again fail; the design says 'once' but does not say what the second null does. Also FlightClaim.await for the deadline-bounded variant must not leave the waiter registered anywhere (waiters are not tracked, so this is fine) but must call the cache-less optimize path so nothing is published without a claim.
issues.suggestion: Specify: loop at most twice; on a second null (or timeout) call PackedCascadesPlanner.optimize(tupleExpr, limits, exploreReorderings, costModel, rangeProvider) (the cache-less overload :420-427) and return without publishing. Test: waiterFallsBackToIndependentPlanningWhenTwoOwnersFail.

issues.issue: The design lists the identity-source change for :660/:667/:742/:751/:816-818 only; verified that snapshotStillCurrent is used solely by the two probe caches (:667, :751) and that all other currentSnapshotIdentity() users (:326 cold synopsis footprint, :634 cold pass estimate, :938 sidecar persist, :1045 sidecar load, :1138 cold synopsis load) are sidecar/synopsis semantics that must keep the sketch identity. Two consumers outside LmdbEstimatorRuntime also read the probe caches: LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.exactBoundedFilterZero (:418-423, EXACT zero evidence with confidence 1.0) and the finite-filter probe at :467-479 that turns a COMPLETE term set into `anchor = actualTermAnchor` for surface estimation. They are estimates, not rewrites, but a stale COMPLETE set there yields an exact 'zero rows' certificate that PackedRootCardinalityCertifier / annotateCertifiedExactZero (LmdbCascadesOptimizer.java:564-577) stamps as rows=0.
issues.suggestion: Keep the design's scope (both probe caches move to the data revision), and add one assertion to LmdbExactFilterProbeCacheTest that isExactBoundedFilterZero re-probes after the data-revision supplier moves even when the sketch identity is unchanged (this is the LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence:420 path). Fixture (:138-142) gains the LongSupplier as the design says.

missedFindings: Decision-cache publication authority: LmdbPlanDecisionCache.publishBuild refuses replacement builds while the stale version is VALID (:1120-1127, :1147-1153) and nothing marks HARD_INVALID on a hard-dependency mismatch (hardInvalid :763 only reached from markEvidenceChanged :1578, no production caller). Any hard-dependency scheme (3.3.2, and today's PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA) degrades to replan-every-time without this; must be part of wp3.

SemanticDependencies has a single indexGeneration/indexIdentity slot (LmdbPlanDecisionCache.java:201-262); the design needs two independent hard dimensions (data revision vs guarantee contents) and the record shape change is not called out in the files list.

Commit visibility precedes the revision bump (TripleStore.java:3412 vs :3415), so a durable txn-id revision still has the plan/probe race window the review calls 'plausible' in 3.5; the design should state it stays open or move the bump before txnManager.reset().

annotateCertifiedExactZero (LmdbCascadesOptimizer.java:564-577) stamps PLANNED_CARDINALITY_ROWS=0 / setResultSizeEstimate(0) on the served plan; verify no executor short-circuits on a planned zero (I found no consumer in core/sail/lmdb main, but the evaluation module was not exhaustively grepped). If one exists, the stale-zero after commit is another 3.3.2-class stale fact that the assumption certificate must cover.
semanticRegressionRisks: 3.3.2 guarantee-only tier as specified: data `:a :p 5` (xsd:integer, guarantee CANONICAL_INTEGER), query `SELECT ?s { ?s :p ?o FILTER(?o = 5) }` (filter dropped, VALUES {5} anchor), then commit `:c :p 5` (another canonical integer; guarantee unchanged). Expected {a,c} via the cached plan (anchor still exact) with a cache hit; with the design's 0L-vs-dataRevision comparison the lookup replans every time (correct rows, cache defeated). Then commit `:d :p "5"^^xsd:int` -> PredicateRangeIdentity changes -> must replan (design intent). Both cases must be tested.

3.3.2 hard data tier: repro exactStoredTermAnchorMustNotSurviveCommitThatAddsValueEqualTerm gives correct rows after the fix, but run the same query a THIRD time and assert optimizer.pipelinePlanCacheHit=true; with publishBuild refusing VALID replacement it will be false forever (perf regression for every FILTER(?o = const) shape).

3.3.1 (A) model equals: `?s :p* ?o` vs `?s :p+ ?o` and GROUP_CONCAT ',' vs '|' now compare unequal everywhere (all stores). Also `LmdbPlanDecisionCache.sameExecutableTemplate` (:1157-1163) and QueryModelNormalizer/FilterOptimizer dedup rely on equals; no test compares a p* tree with a p+ tree (SPARQLParserTest/TestPropPathMisbehaviour compare like with like), so no expected breakage, but run the queryparser and evaluation suites. Dataset `:a :p :b`: Q1 `SELECT ?s ?o { ?s :p* ?o }` = {a|a, a|b, b|b}; Q2 `SELECT ?s ?o { ?s :p+ ?o }` = {a|b}; both orders (Q1 then Q2 and Q2 then Q1) must give these sets.

3.3.5 (a): waiters with the SAME facts must still merge, e.g. data `:a :p 7` with an int-only guarantee [7,7]: concurrent `?s :p 7` and `?s :p 8` (8 is out of range too -> proven empty for 8? no: range [7,7] proves 8 empty) -- use `?s :p 7` twice concurrently (identical facts) -> second must be a non-owner waiter (PackedPlanCacheTest.familyWaiterWithSameConstantStillSharesTheFlight). Owner `?s :p 9` (proven empty) + waiter `?s :p 7` must NOT merge and waiter must return {a}. Verified that facts become extra relation rows during encoding (PackedQueryCodec.deriveFactsAndSaturateRules :375-395) and that PackedObjectPool.hasSameValues compares rawValue (parameter references, vector-independent), so hasSameCacheIdentity separates them.

3.3.5 (b): committed `:a :p 7`; in a dirty transaction add `:b :p 9` (uncommitted) and run `SELECT ?s { ?s :p ?o FILTER(?o = 9) }` in the same transaction: must return {b}. Providerless planning (LmdbCascadesOptimizer.java:130-141 rangeProvider=null, predicateRangeVersion 0 in cacheContext :366) must never reuse the range-fact template published by committed planning; PackedPlanCache.Context.predicateRangeVersion is already in Context.equals for PlanEntry hits, only sameQueryContext lacked it.

3.8.4 (2): cost-model IllegalArgumentException from PackedWinnerTable (non-finite cost) or the certifier (PackedCascadesPlanner.java:739-741) becomes a logged fallback; wp7 saturation bugs would surface as silent plan-quality regressions unless the fallback counter metric is asserted zero in benchmarks and LmdbEstimateAuditHarnessTest.

3.8.4 (3) fail-fast: a query whose UNSUPPORTED relation sits in a branch the packed planner would have pruned (e.g. an unused OPTIONAL over a custom node) planned successfully today and now falls back to the pipeline tree -- correct rows, different plan. Verified the pre-scan is complete: PackedPlanMaterializer throws only for PackedRelOp.UNSUPPORTED (:209, :225-229) and PackedQuery.supportsCacheIdentity scans exactly that op (:162-169); there is no scalar/payload UNSUPPORTED materialization path.

3.3.3 (B): after removing the synopsis version from snapshotVersion(), a sketch rebuild no longer invalidates PackedPlanCache entries through dataRevision; it must reach Context via frontierRevision/leoRevision (both are in Context.equals/planHash, PackedPlanCache.java:219-246). If wp5 mixes it into neither, plans keep stale sketch statistics until the next commit (quality only).

3.9.2: `SELECT * { VALUES (?x ?y) { (UNDEF <urn:a>) (<urn:b> UNDEF) } ?s <urn:p> ?x }` run twice on LMDB; second run is a pipeline-cache hit serving the template rows (LmdbPipelinePlanCacheTest.retainedTemplateOwnsAnImmutableCopyOfBindingRows shows template rows, not caller rows, are installed) -- rows must be identical to the first run and hasBinding must be false for the UNDEF cells (ListBindingSet.hasBinding :98-100 returns getValue != null).

3.9.3: `SELECT ?s ?p { ?s ?p <urn:b> FILTER(?p != <urn:x>) }` over `:a :p1 :b . :a :p2 :c` must return {a|p1}; learned cells for `?p <urn:b>` and `<p1> <urn:b>` must stay distinct (mask differs) and byte-identical keys for constant predicates keep persisted sidecar cells matching.
verifiedClaims: 3.9.2: detachedTemplate copies rows with List.copyOf(values) at LmdbPipelinePlanCache.java:430 and runs for every retainable computed plan (:180-183, retainable = APPLIED_METRIC :403-405); the SPARQL parser builds VALUES rows as ListBindingSet(names, values) with null for UNDEF (TupleExprBuilder.java:2507-2522); ListBindingSet tolerates nulls (:74-100); FactorCostCacheKey.ValueFingerprint.of(null) returns null (:187-190) so estimatedRetainedBytes(template) will not NPE after the fix.

3.9.1: DatasetIdentity.immutable uses Set.copyOf (:501-503); the compliance harness adds a null default graph (SPARQL11UpdateComplianceTest.java:114, SPARQL12UpdateComplianceTest.java:96); LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh.dataset() re-adds via SimpleDataset (LinkedHashSet-backed, SimpleDataset.java:32-38) and routingHash uses only set sizes (:620); record equality stays content-based.

3.3.1: ShapeFingerprint hashes class names, var names/kinds and BSA names only (:308-372); sameSource returns true on TupleExpr.equals before consulting the identity (:847-855); ArbitraryLengthPath.equals/hashCode omit minLength (:231-253); GroupConcat.equals is `instanceof && super.equals` and AbstractAggregateOperator.equals compares arg+distinct only (:47-57); PackedQueryCodec encodes minLength in the ALP payload (:993-994) and the separator as a GROUP_CONCAT scalar child (:1278-1281), so createPlanIdentity separates the colliding queries; cachedResult materializes entry.query() via rebindOriginalBindingSets (:829-833) so the collision is purely in authentication.

3.3.5: Flight.matches admits family waiters on familyIdentity.matches alone (:568-575) while PlanEntry.familyMatches additionally requires query.hasSameCacheIdentity (:489-496); PackedQueryFamilyIdentity.matches compares only parameterSchema + canonicalPackedIdentity computed without a range provider (:74-91, :104-108); parameterizedQueryTemplate survives detached() (:97-102); sameQueryContext omits predicateRangeVersion (:839-845); the waiter path calls cachedResult(awaited, familyIdentity.concreteQuery()) (:215-220). Open question resolved: PackedObjectPool.hasSameValues compares rawValue (parameter references unresolved), so the parameter vector is ignored; range facts appear as extra relation rows via deriveFactsAndSaturateRules (PackedQueryCodec.java:375-395), so hasSameCacheIdentity distinguishes proven-empty from in-range invocations.

3.8.4: FlightClaim.await joins the future (:541-546); Segment.fail completes exceptionally and removes the flight (:713-717); the owner calls cache.fail for RuntimeException|Error (:347-349); LmdbCascadesOptimizer catches only IllegalStateException (:175-186) and annotateCascadesFallback takes IllegalStateException (:681-687); UnsupportedCascadesOperatorException extends CascadesPlanningException extends RuntimeException (not ISE) and is thrown only at materialization (PackedPlanMaterializer.java:225-229); PackedMemoInvariantException extends IllegalStateException; PackedCostSessionFailure extends RuntimeException; LmdbPipelinePlanCache waiters `shared.join()` (:165-171) after abandon() completes exceptionally (:236-244); refresh task failures are already swallowed (PrioritizedRefreshTask.run catch RuntimeException).

3.3.3: snapshotVersion() = max(storageAccess.dataRevision(), synopsis.snapshotVersion()) (LmdbEstimatorRuntime.java:406-410); dataRevision is an in-memory AtomicLong (TripleStore.java:229) incremented per commit (:3415) and never persisted; synopsis version is persisted and grows per rebuild publish (LmdbQuadSynopsisService.java:129-131, :331-332); mdb_txn_id is already read from the write txn (:2314) and from a read txn (:3340); ValueStore and TripleStore open SEPARATE LMDB environments (ValueStore.java:409-425 vs TripleStore.java:273-290), so value-only commits do not bump a TripleStore txn-id revision; PackedPlanCache.newerGeneration uses Long.compareUnsigned on dataRevision (:770-784); the LmdbPlanDecisionCache is in-memory only (no persistence code), so restart concerns are confined to a single post-restart process, exactly as the repro shows.

3.3.2: computePlan runs request-bound optimizers before Cascades (LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.java:112-116); detachedPreparedSource is cloned after them (LmdbCascadesOptimizer.java:174) and is the only input to LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh (:123-128); publishDecision strips the index dependency unless the packed summary declares PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA (:251-254), which derives only from packed rule proofs (PackedPlanDecisionSummary.java:106-109); the data revision lives only in EvidenceSnapshot (:386-396); lookupVersion returns UseAndRefresh('outside-stability-envelope') on evidence drift when semantic deps match (:1687-1698); ensureSemanticsCurrent compares only predicateRangeVersion (:170-173), a hash of encoding+config+flags (LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java:246-256, TripleStore.java:434-448); exactStoredTermFilterAnchor is gated by committedEvidenceUsable (:433) so dirty transactions never get committed-term anchors (why uncommittedOverlayMustSeeOwnValueEqualTerm is green); dirty-txn lookups cannot hit committed plans because lookupExact requires an exact alias whose SemanticContext includes executionSnapshotPresent (:361-371, LmdbPlanDecisionCache.java:1079-1091).
